title: Soundboard Sketch
subtitle: An interactive soundboard for auditory learning and engagement.
key_concept: Auditory feedback and motivation through sound.
visual_metaphor: A cathedral organ with multiple pipes (sound buttons), each labeled with a concept, with amber glow on activation, set against dark stone walls.
why_it_matters: Added a new sensory modality (sound) to the learning experience, expanding beyond visual/text.
zone_change: New domain: Auditory Learning — introduced sound as a learning tool.
